column2: A curated seed dataset for a science-backed pepper breeding calculator and breeding-record platform. It separates verified genetic claims from advisory evidence and unsupported prediction.
Research seed release. Not a clinically, commercially, or legally validated breeding decision system. Independent plant-genetics review is required before activating production phenotype rules.

Genotype inheritance may be exact when parental alleles are verified. Phenotype prediction is enabled only when the literature supports the exact allele, population/background, interaction model, and pathogen/environment context.
Causal or functionally validated gene/allele with strong genetic/mechanistic evidence. Still subject to applicability limits.
Fine-mapped strong candidate, population-specific model, linked marker, or replicated major-effect evidence. Advisory by default.
Association, expression, candidate, or QTL evidence without sufficient causal validation. Not included as production rules in this seed catalog.
This catalog does not predict exact SHU, flavor, yield, fruit weight, wall thickness, or environmental adaptation from cultivar names or parent phenotypes.
Use primary peer-reviewed studies for scientific claims; reviews and official databases guide discovery and normalization but do not replace primary evidence.
Every future prediction run must store catalog version, exact source assertions, parental call status, and assembly/version for genomic coordinates.
Curated loci/genes with evidence grade, allowed claim, forbidden claim, and prediction eligibility.
Atomic claim records suitable for a future approval and versioning workflow.
Bibliographic source registry with DOI/PMID/URL and study limitations.
Data standards and official resources to adopt.
Required work before production release and advanced model development.
